dict.string: PageChime can scan the page you're about to read so its sounds play the moment you reach them. The text is read on your device; the photo is never uploaded or saved.
PageChime listens to your storytelling to play matching sound effects. Your voice is processed during the reading session and is never saved.
PageChime uses speech recognition to detect story events like animals, weather, and actions, so it can play matching sounds. Transcripts are not saved.
